name: Novacon
blurb: The UK's longest-established science fiction convention, run by the Birmingham SF Group each November.

picks: Author; Star Trek, Doctor Who novels

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'NOVACON 55 6 – 8 November 2026 The Palace Hotel, Buxton, Derbyshire'.

notes: The given url (novacon.org.uk) is a parked/for-sale domain unrelated to the convention; the real site is novacon.uk. Venue/city rotates yearly (this year Buxton, Derbyshire, not Birmingham). Author Guest of Honour Una McCormack has a photo on the homepage; Science Guest of Honour Christine Davidson is named in site text/progress reports but has no photo there, so she is listed as text-only.
